_comment: Ad tags that must stay on the site. scripts/verify-ads.mjs (postbuild + CI) and the hourly watchdog fail when a tag is missing from the built or live pages, or when the site CSP (src/lib/csp.ts) blocks its host. Adsterra was removed on 2026-10-01 at the owner's request (low CPM); it is in git history before that date.
